howitworks.title: HOW PULSO WORKS
howitworks.subtitle: From reporting a problem to completing repairs in Caloocan City.

help.assistDesc: Our support team is available during standard operating hours to assist with application issues.
help.hotlinesDesc: For immediate life-threatening infrastructure failures, bypass the app and call these numbers directly.
help.q1: How long does it take for a report to be verified?
help.a1: Most priority reports submitted with clear GPS and photo evidence are reviewed by the engineering AI within 15 minutes. Manual review may take up to 2 hours.
help.a2: Your Trust Score increases as you submit accurate, high-quality reports that get verified and resolved. Higher scores grant your future reports priority routing.
help.q3: Can I report issues outside my registered barangay?
help.a3: Yes. While your home base is pinned to your profile, the Quick Report tool uses your live phone GPS to tag the exact coordinate of the hazard, regardless of where you are in the city.
